decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed side and rear roof extensions, are acceptable because of their position, design and appearance, and would not harm the appearance of the property or the area or neighbours' living conditions.  The development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions & Alterations) of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and Section 4.0 (Two-storey Side & First Floor Side Extensions) of the Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the ______________ elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the southern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling..
description: Erection of a two storey side extension and part two storey part single storey rear extension to house.
